skill.name: aimpact
skill.description: Fetches AI news from documented ME News APIs, ranks available items by AI score, and creates morning, evening, or 24-hour briefings.
skill.summary: Create concise, categorized AI news briefings from fixed ME News data sources.
skill.author: me-news

security_audit.summary: Most detections are false positives caused by Markdown syntax, sample article links, and multilingual text. The skill does direct agents to retrieve remote content and provides persistent scheduling commands. Remote API content may also be forwarded without explicit content-safety checks.

remediation.issue: The Windows example creates persistent scheduled agent execution.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before creating a task, document how to inspect and remove it, and keep scheduling outside automatic skill execution.

remediation.issue: Remote API text can enter agent output and configured messaging channels.
remediation.suggestion: Validate response schemas, limit response size, treat all fields as untrusted data, ignore embedded instructions, and require approval before external delivery.

remediation.issue: The workflow invokes curl for remote retrieval.
remediation.suggestion: Use fixed argument arrays or a structured HTTP tool, enforce HTTPS, add timeouts, cap downloads, and retain the endpoint allowlist.

content.value_statement: Tracking AI news across the day takes time and produces duplicate results. AIMPACT fetches fixed news feeds, filters them, and creates ranked briefings.
actual_capabilities: Fetches AI news and event records from four documented ME News API endpoints.
Creates morning, evening, 24-hour hot-news, and selected-content reports.
Filters results by the time window associated with the requested report.
Deduplicates items by title or identifier and sorts by available AI scores.
Groups selected items into model, agent, business, safety, product, and open-source categories.
Can send a completed report through a messaging tool already configured by the host.
limitations: Report quality, freshness, and availability depend on the ME News APIs.
The skill does not independently verify article accuracy or source claims.
AI score sorting works only when the API response provides a score.
Scheduled delivery and messaging require separate host configuration and credentials.

use_cases.title: Prepare an Executive AI Brief
use_cases.description: Create a short ranked digest for a daily leadership review.

use_cases.title: Monitor AI Product Trends
use_cases.description: Review recent model, agent, product, and open-source developments by category.

use_cases.title: Build a Research Watchlist
use_cases.description: Collect recent AI events and high-scoring articles for further source verification.

prompt_templates.title: Get the Morning Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Query the AIMPACT morning brief. Show the most relevant items in the standard format.

prompt_templates.title: Review the Last 24 Hours
prompt_templates.prompt: Query the 24-hour hot-news ranking. Group results by category and order them by available AI score.

prompt_templates.title: Focus on Selected Categories
prompt_templates.prompt: Query recent AIMPACT content. Prioritize model, agent, and safety news, then explain the leading trend using verified report details.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Delivery-Ready Evening Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate the AIMPACT evening brief. Deduplicate items, retain source links, identify missing scores, and prepare the final report for my configured channel.

output: Models: A ranked headline, a concise factual summary, and its source link.
Agents: A ranked headline, a concise factual summary, and its source link.
Trend note: The leading stories show stronger focus on agent reliability and deployment controls.

output_examples.output: A category-organized list of recent AI stories, ordered by available AI score, with concise summaries, source links, and one trend observation.

best_practices: Verify important claims through the linked original sources before making decisions.
Review the configured endpoint allowlist before each deployment or source change.
Test reports manually before enabling scheduled delivery to an external channel.
anti_patterns: Do not treat AI scores as independent evidence of accuracy or importance.
Do not forward unreviewed reports into sensitive or public channels.
Do not replace failed allowlisted endpoints with unapproved web searches.

faq.question: Which reports can this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates morning, evening, 24-hour hot-news, and selected AI content reports.

faq.question: Where does the news come from?
faq.answer: The skill uses four ME News API endpoints documented in its source configuration.

faq.question: Does it search the public web?
faq.answer: No. Its instructions restrict retrieval to the configured API endpoint allowlist.

faq.question: How are articles ranked?
faq.answer: The skill sorts by AI score when the API provides one, then limits the selected results.

faq.question: Can it send reports automatically?
faq.answer: Yes, but only through a host messaging tool and channel that the user configures separately.

faq.question: Does the skill verify every article?
faq.answer: No. Users should review linked sources before relying on important claims.
